title: Hold a weapons dealer permit
what: Buy, sell or manufacture prohibited weapons in a weapons dealing business only under a weapons dealer permit.

sources.title: Weapons Prohibition Act 1998 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
